"""Mappings for the five tables created by migration 0001_telegram.

These classes describe the existing schema. Importing them does not create tables.
"""

from datetime import datetime
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import (
    BigInteger, CheckConstraint, DateTime, ForeignKeyConstraint, Identity,
    Index, Integer, String, Text, UniqueConstraint, func, text,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID as PostgreSQLUUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class TelegramIdentity(Base):
    __tablename__ = "telegram_identities"
    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint("bot_id > 0"),
        CheckConstraint("telegram_user_id > 0"),
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "telegram_user_id"),
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "id"),
    )

    id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    bot_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    telegram_user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    username: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    first_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    last_name: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    display_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    last_seen_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())


class ConversationSession(Base):
    __tablename__ = "conversation_sessions"
    __table_args__ = (
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id"],
            ["telegram_identities.scope", "telegram_identities.bot_id", "telegram_identities.id"],
        ),
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "id"),
        CheckConstraint("status IN ('ACTIVE','CLOSED')"),
        CheckConstraint("last_sequence >= 0"),
        CheckConstraint("(status='ACTIVE' AND closed_at IS NULL) OR (status='CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL)"),
        Index(
            "one_active_session", "scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id",
            unique=True, postgresql_where=text("status='ACTIVE'"),
        ),
    )

    id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    bot_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    identity_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    chat_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False, server_default=text("'ACTIVE'"))
    last_sequence: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False, server_default=text("0"))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    last_activity_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    closed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)


class TelegramInbox(Base):
    __tablename__ = "telegram_inbox"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "update_id"),
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "id"),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id"],
            ["telegram_identities.scope", "telegram_identities.bot_id", "telegram_identities.id"],
        ),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "session_id"],
            ["conversation_sessions.scope", "conversation_sessions.bot_id", "conversation_sessions.identity_id", "conversation_sessions.chat_id", "conversation_sessions.id"],
        ),
        CheckConstraint("kind IN ('TEXT','START','NEW','SESSION','INVALID','UNSUPPORTED')"),
        CheckConstraint("status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','RETRY','READY','DONE','DELIVERY_FAILED')"),
        CheckConstraint("attempts >= 0"),
        Index("inbox_pending", "scope", "bot_id", "status", "next_attempt_at", "received_order"),
    )

    id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    bot_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    update_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    identity_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    chat_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    message_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    received_order: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, Identity(always=True), nullable=False, unique=True)
    kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    content: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(24), nullable=False, server_default=text("'PENDING'"))
    session_id: Mapped[UUID | None] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True)
    attempts: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, server_default=text("0"))
    next_attempt_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    error_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())


class ConversationMessage(Base):
    __tablename__ = "conversation_messages"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "session_id", "sequence"),
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "session_id", "id"),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "session_id"],
            ["conversation_sessions.scope", "conversation_sessions.bot_id", "conversation_sessions.identity_id", "conversation_sessions.chat_id", "conversation_sessions.id"],
        ),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "inbox_id"],
            ["telegram_inbox.scope", "telegram_inbox.bot_id", "telegram_inbox.identity_id", "telegram_inbox.chat_id", "telegram_inbox.id"],
        ),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "session_id", "reply_to_id"],
            ["conversation_messages.scope", "conversation_messages.bot_id", "conversation_messages.identity_id", "conversation_messages.chat_id", "conversation_messages.session_id", "conversation_messages.id"],
        ),
        CheckConstraint("sequence > 0"),
        CheckConstraint("role IN ('USER','ASSISTANT')"),
        CheckConstraint("(role='USER' AND reply_to_id IS NULL AND model IS NULL AND provider_response_id IS NULL) OR (role='ASSISTANT' AND reply_to_id IS NOT NULL AND model IS NOT NULL)"),
        Index("one_user_per_inbox", "scope", "bot_id", "inbox_id", unique=True, postgresql_where=text("role='USER'")),
        Index("one_assistant_per_user", "scope", "bot_id", "reply_to_id", unique=True, postgresql_where=text("role='ASSISTANT'")),
        Index("message_history", "scope", "bot_id", "session_id", "sequence"),
    )

    id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    bot_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    identity_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    chat_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    session_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    sequence: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    content: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    inbox_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    inbound_update_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    reply_to_id: Mapped[UUID | None] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True)
    model: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=True)
    provider_response_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())


class TelegramOutbox(Base):
    __tablename__ = "telegram_outbox"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("scope", "bot_id", "inbox_id", "response_kind", "chunk_number"),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "session_id"],
            ["conversation_sessions.scope", "conversation_sessions.bot_id", "conversation_sessions.identity_id", "conversation_sessions.chat_id", "conversation_sessions.id"],
        ),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "inbox_id"],
            ["telegram_inbox.scope", "telegram_inbox.bot_id", "telegram_inbox.identity_id", "telegram_inbox.chat_id", "telegram_inbox.id"],
        ),
        ForeignKeyConstraint(
            ["scope", "bot_id", "identity_id", "chat_id", "session_id", "assistant_message_id"],
            ["conversation_messages.scope", "conversation_messages.bot_id", "conversation_messages.identity_id", "conversation_messages.chat_id", "conversation_messages.session_id", "conversation_messages.id"],
        ),
        CheckConstraint("response_kind IN ('AI','COMMAND','ERROR')"),
        CheckConstraint("chunk_number >= 0"),
        CheckConstraint("status IN ('PENDING','SENDING','SENT','FAILED','UNKNOWN')"),
        CheckConstraint("attempts >= 0"),
        CheckConstraint("retry_after_seconds >= 0"),
        CheckConstraint("(response_kind='AI' AND assistant_message_id IS NOT NULL) OR (response_kind IN ('COMMAND','ERROR') AND assistant_message_id IS NULL)"),
        CheckConstraint("status<>'SENT' OR telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL"),
        Index("outbox_pending", "scope", "bot_id", "status", "next_attempt_at"),
    )

    id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    bot_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    identity_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    chat_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=False)
    session_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    inbox_id: Mapped[UUID] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False)
    assistant_message_id: Mapped[UUID | None] = mapped_column(PostgreSQLUUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True)
    response_kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False)
    chunk_number: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    content: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=False, server_default=text("'PENDING'"))
    telegram_message_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(BigInteger, nullable=True)
    attempts: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, server_default=text("0"))
    next_attempt_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    retry_after_seconds: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, server_default=text("0"))
    error_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=func.now())

"""One serial durable worker. No transactions span provider/send I/O."""

import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncConnection

from app.ai.openrouter import AIError, OpenRouterClient
from app.ai.prompts import build_prompt
from app.channels.telegram.sender import Sender, split_chunks
from app.chat.repositories import Repository, Row
from app.core.database import Database


class Worker:
    def __init__(
        self,
        database: Database,
        repository: Repository,
        ai: OpenRouterClient,
        sender: Sender,
    ) -> None:
        self.database = database
        self.repository = repository
        self.ai = ai
        self.sender = sender
        self.stopping = asyncio.Event()
        self.healthy = False

    async def recover(self) -> None:
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            await self.repository.recover_sending(connection)
            await self.repository.suppress_tails_after_unknown(connection)
            # PROCESSING may represent an accepted provider request. Preserve USER
            # and create a safe error response without automatic regeneration.
            for inbox in await self.repository.processing_inboxes(connection):
                session_id = inbox["session_id"]
                if session_id is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("PROCESSING_SESSION_MISSING")
                await self.repository.outbox(
                    connection,
                    inbox,
                    session_id,
                    "ERROR",
                    [
                        "Permintaan AI sebelumnya terputus. "
                        "Kirim pertanyaan baru untuk mencoba lagi."
                    ],
                )
                await self.repository.mark_ready(connection, inbox, "AI_CRASH_UNKNOWN")
        self.healthy = True

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            while not self.stopping.is_set():
                inbox = await self.next_inbox()
                if inbox is None:
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                    continue
                next_attempt = inbox["next_attempt_at"]
                now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                if next_attempt is not None and next_attempt > now:
                    await asyncio.sleep(min(1.0, (next_attempt - now).total_seconds()))
                    continue
                if inbox["status"] == "READY":
                    await self.deliver(inbox)
                else:
                    await self.process(inbox)
        finally:
            self.healthy = False

    async def next_inbox(self) -> Row | None:
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            return await self.repository.next_inbox(connection)

    async def process(self, inbox: Row) -> None:
        prompt: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            identity = await self.repository.identity(connection, inbox)
            if identity is None:
                raise RuntimeError("IDENTITY_MISSING")
            if inbox["session_id"] is None:
                session = await self.repository.session(
                    connection, inbox, reset=inbox["kind"] == "NEW"
                )
                session_id = session["id"]
            else:
                session_id = inbox["session_id"]
            if inbox["kind"] != "TEXT":
                await self.command(connection, inbox, session_id, identity["display_name"])
                return
            user = await self.repository.existing_user_message(connection, inbox, session_id)
            if user is None:
                user_id = await self.repository.message(
                    connection, inbox, session_id, "USER", inbox["content"]
                )
            else:
                user_id = user["id"]
            pairs = await self.repository.completed_history(connection, inbox, session_id)
            prompt = build_prompt(
                identity["display_name"], identity["username"], pairs, inbox["content"]
            )
            await self.repository.mark_processing(connection, inbox, session_id)
        attempts = inbox["attempts"] + 1
        try:
            completion = await self.ai.reply(prompt)
        except AIError as error:
            async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
                if error.retryable and attempts < 3:
                    next_attempt = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(
                        seconds=max(error.delay, attempts * 5)
                    )
                    await self.repository.mark_retry(
                        connection, inbox, error.code, next_attempt
                    )
                    return
                await self.repository.outbox(
                    connection, inbox, session_id, "ERROR", [self.error_message(error.code)]
                )
                await self.repository.mark_ready(connection, inbox, error.code)
            return
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            assistant_id = await self.repository.message(
                connection,
                inbox,
                session_id,
                "ASSISTANT",
                completion.content,
                reply_to=user_id,
                model=completion.model,
                response_id=completion.response_id,
            )
            await self.repository.outbox(
                connection, inbox, session_id, "AI",
                split_chunks(completion.content), assistant_id,
            )
            await self.repository.mark_ready(connection, inbox, None)

    async def command(
        self,
        connection: AsyncConnection,
        inbox: Row,
        session_id: UUID,
        name: str,
    ) -> None:
        if inbox["kind"] == "START":
            answer = f"Halo, {name}! Silakan kirim pertanyaan. Sesi: {session_id}"
        elif inbox["kind"] == "NEW":
            answer = f"Sesi baru dibuat, {name}. Sesi: {session_id}"
        elif inbox["kind"] == "SESSION":
            answer = f"{name}, sesi aktif Anda: {session_id}"
        elif inbox["kind"] == "INVALID":
            answer = "Kirim pesan teks berisi 1 sampai 4000 karakter."
        else:
            answer = "Perintah tersedia: /start, /new, /session."
        await self.repository.outbox(
            connection, inbox, session_id, "COMMAND", split_chunks(answer)
        )
        await self.repository.mark_command_ready(connection, inbox, session_id)

    def error_message(self, code: str) -> str:
        if code == "AI_NOT_CONFIGURED":
            return "AI belum dikonfigurasi. Operator perlu mengisi OPENROUTER_API_KEY dan AI_MODEL."
        if code in ("AI_HTTP_401", "AI_HTTP_403"):
            return "Akses AI ditolak. Hubungi operator untuk memeriksa konfigurasi."
        if code == "AI_HTTP_402":
            return "Saldo layanan AI tidak mencukupi. Hubungi operator."
        if code == "AI_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN":
            return (
                "Koneksi AI terputus; hasil permintaan tidak diketahui. "
                "Kirim pertanyaan baru bila perlu."
            )
        return "Layanan AI belum dapat menjawab. Silakan kirim pertanyaan baru nanti."

    async def deliver(self, inbox: Row) -> None:
        retry_due: datetime | None = None
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            chunk = await self.repository.pending_outbox(connection, inbox)
            if chunk is None:
                if await self.repository.has_failed_outbox(connection, inbox):
                    await self.repository.mark_delivery_failed(connection, inbox)
                else:
                    await self.repository.mark_done(connection, inbox)
                return
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            if chunk["next_attempt_at"] is not None and chunk["next_attempt_at"] > now:
                retry_due = chunk["next_attempt_at"]
            else:
                await self.repository.mark_sending(connection, inbox, chunk)
        if retry_due is not None:
            # Wait outside the transaction, then reread queue state in run().
            while not self.stopping.is_set():
                remaining = (retry_due - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).total_seconds()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(min(1.0, remaining))
            return
        delivery = await self.sender.send(
            inbox["chat_id"], chunk["content"], chunk["attempts"] + 1
        )
        next_attempt = None
        if delivery.status == "PENDING":
            next_attempt = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=delivery.retry_after)
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            await self.repository.mark_outbox_result(
                connection, inbox, chunk, delivery.status, delivery.code,
                delivery.message_id, next_attempt, delivery.retry_after,
            )
            if delivery.status in ("UNKNOWN", "FAILED"):
                await self.repository.fail_later_chunks(connection, inbox, chunk)
        if delivery.status == "PENDING":
            await asyncio.sleep(min(delivery.retry_after, 1))

"""Operator-run async PostgreSQL migrations; no startup schema creation."""

import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

from alembic import context
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool

from app.chat.entities import Base
from app.core.database import (
    COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    load_database_settings,
)

load_dotenv(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / ".env", override=False)
target_metadata = Base.metadata


def migrate(connection: Connection) -> None:
    context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_online() -> None:
    settings = load_database_settings()
    engine = create_async_engine(
        settings.url,
        poolclass=NullPool,
        connect_args={
            "timeout": CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
            "command_timeout": COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        },
    )
    try:
        async with engine.connect() as connection:
            await connection.run_sync(migrate)
    finally:
        await engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    settings = load_database_settings()
    context.configure(
        url=settings.url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()
else:
    asyncio.run(run_online())

# SQLAlchemy chat persistence refactor: phase 1 worker proposal

Baseline: parent memory version 29, based solely on the supplied source bundle. This is a proposed file set for orchestrator baseline comparison and review; it is not a claim that files were written in the workspace.

Proposed paths: `app/chat/entities.py` (new), `app/chat/repositories.py`, `app/chat/worker.py`, `migrations/env.py`, and this report (new). No removals, dependency changes, or revision changes are proposed.

The five DeclarativeBase mappings describe migration `0001_telegram`: column types and nullability, server defaults, identity generation, checks, unique and composite foreign key constraints, and queue, history and partial indexes. Alembic receives `Base.metadata` in both online and offline configuration. The existing migration remains the only schema creation path.

Repository methods own intake, sessions, messages, outbox, recovery, queue reads, completed history, inbox state changes, and delivery state changes. Queries use mapped tables and SQLAlchemy expressions. Scope and bot are bound from the repository instance, with identity and chat ownership conditions on conversation operations. History keeps the scoped USER to ASSISTANT join, completed inbox filter, current inbox exclusion, descending sequence limit of 32, and chronological prompt order. Recovery retains correlated earlier failed or unknown chunk suppression. Existing conflict keys, UUID generation, sequence increment, and row mapping boundary are preserved.

The worker retains its transaction blocks around recovery, queue read, processing preparation, AI error or success persistence, delivery selection, and send result persistence. Provider and sender I/O and waits remain outside transactions. Commands, retry limits and delays, cancellation behavior, status and error strings, and conservative crash recovery are preserved. Database advisory lock code is untouched.

Checks: NOT RUN BY POLICY. No imports, tests, startup, migrations, database operations, shell commands, or filesystem reads were executed. The proposal has not been compared with the current working tree or compiled against installed SQLAlchemy.

Recommended later checks after review and explicit testing request: metadata parity with migration 0001, PostgreSQL compilation of upsert and correlated recovery update, scoped history and queue ordering, intake idempotency, one USER per inbox, crash recovery, retry and delivery transitions, and transaction boundaries around provider and sender calls. Existing repository and conversation tests may need separate phase 2 interface updates.

Remaining risk: source only review cannot establish installed API compatibility, metadata autogenerate parity, or runtime behavior against PostgreSQL. Orchestrator should compare each proposed path against the baseline and inspect the actual diff before application.
